 S.NATURE's Aqua Squalane Collection Becomes #1 Seller on OLIVE YOUNG's TikTok Shop
 Provided by PR Newswire 2026년 10월 29일 오후 12:15:00 
 S.NATURE's Aqua Squalane Collection Becomes #1 Seller on OLIVE YOUNG's TikTok Shop
 S.NATURE's Aqua Squalane Collection Becomes #1 Seller on OLIVE YOUNG's TikTok Shop
 PR Newswire
 LOS ANGELES, Oct. 29, 2026
 The Korean skincare brand celebrates bestseller momentum for its Aqua Squalane Moisturizing Cream and Wrapping Mask 
 LOS ANGELES , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Korean skincare brand S.NATURE announces that it has become the #1 Top Seller in OLIVE YOUNG's TikTok Shop, marking a milestone for the brand's presence in social commerce.
 The brand's top sellers, the Aqua Squalane Moisturizing Cream and Aqua Squalane Moisturizing Cream Wrapping Mask Sheets, have seen strong demand from shoppers. As of Oct. 19, both products rank among the most-sold items on the verified OLIVE YOUNG Finds storefront, placing S.NATURE's Aqua Squalane Collection alongside leading Korean beauty offerings on the shop.
 The collection offers two complementary skincare formats: the Aqua Squalane Moisturizing Cream, Korea's No. 1 moisturizing cream, Olive Young Triple Award Winner!(10 Million+ Units Sold) and a favorite among K-pop makeup artists, available in a 60 mL tube; and the Aqua Squalane Moisturizing Cream Wrapping Mask Sheets, a no-transfer wrapping mask infused with an entire jar of the moisturizing cream.
 "We're thrilled to see shoppers in the U.S. discover S.NATURE through OLIVE YOUNG's TikTok Shop," said Hyerin Kim, Manager at S.NATURE. "The response to our Aqua Squalane collection is an exciting milestone as we continue bringing our approach to lasting hydration to more to the U.S. market and showcase how the brand has become a staple among shoppers in Korea." 
 The bestseller placements put a spotlight on S.NATURE within OLIVE YOUNG Finds' multi brand assortment. With both a daily moisturizer and a sheet mask among the shop's top sellers, the milestone also brings attention to the wider Aqua Squalane collection.
 S.NATURE's Aqua Squalane Moisturizing Cream and Aqua Squalane Moisturizing Cream Wrapping Mask Sheets are available through the verified OLIVE YOUNG Finds storefront on TikTok Shop at   https://shop.tiktok.com/us/store/olive-young/7494472236496947018 
 About S.NATURE S.NATURE, meaning "Skin Like Nature," is a Korean skincare brand dedicated to creating safe, high-performance skincare built on carefully selected ingredients and thoughtful formulation. Best known for its Aqua Squalane collection, the brand focuses on long-lasting  hydration while prioritizing ingredient safety and products developed for all skin types. Informed by clinical research. S.NATURE continues to earn recognition through the OLIVE YOUNG Awards and a growing presence in global beauty retail.
